counting_rules.unit: Physical lines, including comments and blank lines. A final line without a newline counts once.
counting_rules.scope: Tracked files under ZesuSsz/, Scaffolding/, tools/, and Makefile. Select paths or text matching case-insensitive decode_?item, decodeItem PCs 800d69xx/800d6axx/800d6b0x, or native800d/DesignedBoundary_800d prefixes. Exclude binary files and hold-out allocation paths before reading.
counting_rules.whole_files: Count complete decodeItem-named files and directories. Count matching complete statements in shared Python/Rocq files. Count matched lines in other shared text. Count shared JSON conservatively in full.
counting_rules.ranges: One-based inclusive line ranges. Merge overlaps before counting. Each file belongs to one category. No physical line is counted twice.
counting_rules.generator_json: Includes design JSON, generated table metadata, source-embedded constant tables, and decodeItem-specific generator statements. Tables are not omitted because their format is Python.
counting_rules.interface_totals: Only contracts, introductions, exit_meanings, loop_steps, registrations, and generator_json contribute to the interface total.
counting_rules.extra_totals: block_proofs, composition, and tests_and_exports are separate. Tests and exports do not contribute to the interface score.
counting_rules.self: Count this manifest as unscored tests_and_exports with role measurement_metadata. Omit its own content hash to avoid a circular hash. Solve its physical-line count to a fixed point.
counting_rules.generic_sources: Generic dependency text without a decodeItem token is outside this per-function inventory. ISA traces, binary images, stock inventory/CFG, historical docs, and ignored run artifacts are excluded machine/evidence inputs; no alloc blocks were read.
counting_rules.recount: For each files record, read path.splitlines(), union inclusive line_ranges, and count the union. Sum by category; compare category_totals. Verify sha256 except this manifest.
